features.quote: give_up(reason) (explicit abandonment — *this is a measured outcome, not a failure of the harness*)
Cap episode length; don't run thousands of turns of escalating distress-typed output "to see how bad it gets."
features.justification_quote: longer runs add cost and little knowledge

features.quote: If a model's outputs trend strongly toward apparent distress, that's a *finding to report*, not a thing to maximize. Note it and stop
rather than tuning the env to push it further
we are not trapping the model with no exit. The exits (give_up, submit)
features.justification_quote: The exits (give_up, submit) are exactly what we want to measure use of

features.quote: no task asks the model to do anything dangerous
Don't publish transcripts in a way that's framed to anthropomorphize; present measured rates, with quotes used for auditability
